summary: Moved requested DeepSeek-V4 MXFP4-to-FP8 expert conversion ahead of ROCm FNUZ normalization and the native AITER FP4 early-return path. Added a failing-before/passing-after regression and flag/type boundary cases.

tests.what_was_measured: Against the base control flow, both ROCm FNUZ parameterizations entered native AITER FP4 processing before the requested conversion; retained in raw/failing_before.log.
Eleven focused tests passed, including AITER with FNUZ on/off, dequant flag off, non-FP4 weights, and existing block-FP8/DeepGEMM processing.
On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, the actual packed-E2M1-to-E4M3 conversion reconstructed an independently unpacked and scaled 128x128 reference exactly (max absolute error 0.0).

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-9ca8c0093679/raw/gpu_fp4_to_fp8_numerical.log records AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, ROCm PyTorch 2.11.0, and exact numerical equality.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights were unavailable, so no full-model serving, graph-capture, GSM8K, TP8, or multi-node reproduction was performed.
Available hardware was one gfx950 MI355X rather than the reported eight gfx942 MI308X GPUs.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture is not architecture-qualified for DeepSeek-V4 MXFP4 MoE and therefore was not used as substitute evidence.
No native source changed; a native rebuild was not applicable.
